scope: bounded independent static review of listed source inputs; no execution qualification

Original just fix remains first. Added same-package cargo clippy --tests --locked without --fix and with -D warnings. Any command failure or source drift stops preparation; nonmutating lint cannot rescue an already changed source. No new native tests or expanded timeout.
Relative to v4, only the SHA256 of the admitted strict preparation driver changed to the exact v6 bytes. Existing complete operator discovery and original thirteen-case scopes remain unchanged.

Actual exact33 discovery is list-only and separately accounted; execution requires unique exact libtest case set and matching original summaries.

XML is retained at actual wrapper granularity, not relabeled as33 Rust cases.

Corrected the review finding that a final source drift could leave a positive status string while passed=false. Finalize occurs after the last source check, and failure cannot be revived. Transitive source helper bytes are retained. Receipt explicitly distinguishes one target from the original whole shard and the workflow keyless BuildBuddy path without exposing a token.

Full before/after byte comparison shows only SOURCE_SHA, TESTED_SHA and SOURCE_TREE workflow constants changed. Driver/checker/scope bytes identical to the reviewed eleven-case version; all original internal test budgets, exact discovery/fresh JUnit equality, skip/retry rejection and aggregate failure behavior remain.

Full before/after byte comparison shows only the same three workflow identity constants changed. Driver/checker bytes match reviewed Bazel v2. No production source, legacy isolation refusal, shared branch, wrapper arguments or timeout policy is changed by the observer.

limits: Static review is not a Windows/Linux execution, full workspace result, proof of durability or production installation.
